features.feature_characterization#

Feature characterization focused on per-feature behavior versus glucose.

This script intentionally does NOT perform feature selection. It reads the same train input used by features/feature_selection.py: datasetConfig.get_splitted_features_file_name(“train”).

Calculate the number of unique values for each feature in the DataFrame.

Parameters: df (pd.DataFrame): The input DataFrame containing features.

Returns: pd.DataFrame: A DataFrame with two columns: ‘feature’ and ‘n_unique’,

where ‘feature’ is the feature name and ‘n_unique’ is the number of unique values for that feature.
